posts.text: Start 2027 by pairing each new habit with a tiny one-tick win; consistency beats ambition. ✅ This free Notion tracker logs six daily habits, scores your day and shows weekly and monthly progress. https://marketplus-news.github.io/ #Productivity #Notion

🇩🇪 Cost-of-living protests turned violent in several German cities overnight; rioters looted shops in Frankfurt and police used water cannons. In France, more than 320,000 people marched. Social unrest adds to European political risk. #Germany #Europe

⚡ Russian strikes on energy infrastructure left more than 650 settlements in Ukraine's Zhytomyr region without power, the regional governor said. Kyiv says Russian troop losses hit a record 54,400 in October. Risk sentiment stays fragile. #Ukraine #Markets

🇬🇧 Former UK chancellor Rachel Reeves says Britain's future is in the EU, writing that Brexit made the country "poorer, weaker and less secure." PM Andy Burnham seeks eased trade rules at an EU summit this month. Sterling may track the talks. #Brexit #GBP

🔐 Binance says it has covered 90% of the record $6.3 billion stolen in its hack, which the FBI attributes to North Korea-backed group TraderTraitor. Some withdrawals resumed Sunday in phases. Crypto sentiment may stay cautious. #Binance #Crypto

🚢 Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets its conditions, including sanctions relief and frozen funds, after Qatari mediation. Trump said talks are "going fine." Oil markets stay on alert. #Oil #Iran

📈 Reliance Industries posted a record quarterly profit, up 33.8%, on $37.8B in revenue.
Its Jio unit raised $3.2B in India's largest IPO ever.
Still, the stock sits near a 52-week low as investors weigh how long refining margins last.
#Reliance #Earnings
🛢️ OPEC+ is set to keep its oil production targets unchanged for December, a source told A hold keeps the supply outlook steady for crude markets heading into winter. #Oil #OPEC

📉 OpenAI cut the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion and now seeks about $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the FT reported. The Nasdaq fell 2.9% on Friday and sits 7.8% below its Oct. 6 record. Tech sentiment stays fragile. #AI #Stocks
Holiday gifts add up fast when nobody tracks them. 🎁 The free Christmas Gift List 2026 (Excel/Google Sheets) tracks budget, price and Bought/Wrapped with auto totals. #Christmas #PersonalFinance

📉 Intel shares fell 29% on Friday to about $65, their worst day since 1974, after weak fourth-quarter guidance and server chip supply problems. Data center and AI revenue still rose nearly 80%. Chip stocks may stay volatile. #Intel #Stocks
🗳️ Elon Musk has spent $446 million on the US midterm elections, according to a Guardian analysis, with the vote days away. Policy risk for tech and energy stocks may stay in focus. #Midterms #Stocks

🔥 Explosions were reported overnight in Ufa, Russia, and the city's airport was closed. OSINT group Astra says a key gasoline unit at the Bashneft-Novoil refinery is on fire; officials have not commented. Traders are watching Russian fuel supply. #Oil #Russia
